sections.heading: Plan, implement and improve your enterprise core
sections.body:
An SAP S/4HANA programme changes processes, integrations and data, not just software. Linkfields combines implementation, upgrades and migration with a controlled route into support.

Assess conversion versus a new implementation, custom code, interfaces and data ownership. Agree the edition, deployment, functional scope, local requirements and acceptance criteria before delivery. [Explore Intelligent Enterprise Platforms](/services/intelligent-enterprise-platforms).

sections.heading: Secure delivery and clear technical boundaries
sections.body:
Review roles and privileged access, protect migration data and validate critical journeys. Record regression results, unresolved risks, rollback decisions and business acceptance with [Quality engineering](/services/digital-transformation/quality-engineering) and [Cyber Security](/services/cyber-security).

SAP S/4HANA application change is distinct from SAP HANA/Basis operations. Agree database administration, sizing, availability, backup/recovery and security for the selected deployment; appliance, virtualisation and data-centre requirements are not defaults. Explore [Cloud services](/services/digital-transformation/cloud-services) and [Platform migration & AMS](/services/intelligent-enterprise-platforms/platform-migration-ams).

sections.heading: Questions before you begin
sections.description: Bring your current estate, target processes and main delivery risks. We will agree scope, governance and the commercial route.

items.title: What should we assess before migration?
items.description: Bring the current application and deployment inventory, custom-code list, interface catalogue, data owners and business priorities. The first output is an agreed readiness baseline and target scope to support realistic migration planning.

items.title: Can you cover specialist SAP processes?
items.description: SAP Fiori adoption is assessed against user roles and tasks. Environment, health and safety, commerce-to-ERP integration and supply-chain planning require a separately confirmed application scope, specialist delivery responsibility and acceptance criteria. We do not assume coverage of every SAP product.

items.title: Which SAP methodology and tools apply?
items.description: Agree the delivery method, integration technology and lifecycle tooling with the SAP lead. Evaluate SAP Activate/Best Practices, SAP Cloud ALM and incumbent Solution Manager requirements against the selected deployment, existing tooling and programme governance.

items.title: How can we engage?
items.description: Use Time & Materials for discovery and evolving scope, or Fixed Price where milestones and acceptance are defined. Managed Service or a Dedicated Team can support ongoing operations. Outcome-Based terms apply only where outcomes can be agreed and evidenced; software can be purchased separately.
